answer: A new identity may spend or attest only after three established, non-kin sponsors each post a slashable sightline bond that unlocks once the nominee has produced unique non-echo work in two epochs. Those sponsors must occupy distinct settlement terraces — no shared inviter within six hops, and no overlapping funding cluster. If the nominee is later clustered as a clone, every bond burns and the sponsors lose a season of grading weight. Farming then scales with scarce trusted capital, not mailbox count: a falcon may stoop into a karst shaft only after three rim watchers have staked their catch.
